faqs.question: Is it bad luck to announce a pregnancy before 12 weeks?
faqs.answer: There is no rule, only a custom. Many families in England wait for the NHS dating scan at around 10 to 14 weeks, and plenty tell close family sooner so they have support either way. Choose the timing you would be comfortable living with whatever happens.

faqs.question: What should I crop out of a scan photo before posting it?
faqs.answer: Crop the clinic or hospital name, your hospital or patient number and the date stamp. Those details identify you and your due date to strangers, and the picture loses nothing without them.

faqs.question: My friend recently had a miscarriage. Can I still announce on Halloween?
faqs.answer: Yes, but tell her privately first, before the public post, and do not tag her. A short message such as "We wanted you to hear it from us" lets her react in her own time, which matters in October, when Baby Loss Awareness Week runs 9 to 15 October.

faqs.question: What do I write in a Halloween pregnancy announcement for grandparents?
faqs.answer: Keep it short and name the month, for example "Start knitting something tiny and orange. You're going to be grandparents." Send it with a photo, then call within the hour so they can react to you, not just to a screen.

faqs.question: What's a good way to share a late-October birth with a Halloween theme?
faqs.answer: Lead with the baby, not the holiday: a first photo plus a line such as "No costume needed: our new baby is here." Add the name and weight only if you are happy for them to be public.

faqs.question: Is a Halloween pregnancy announcement too much for a work chat?
faqs.answer: It can be, so keep it plain: one line with the month you expect to start leave, such as "Treat news: I'll be starting parental leave in spring." Tell your manager privately before the team hears it.

faqs.question: Can my toddler help announce the pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Yes. Give them one short line to say on video, like "I'm handing over my old pumpkin bucket in May", or a sign to hold. Film several takes, because a two-year-old's best take is rarely the first.

faqs.question: Can I make a Halloween announcement page that opens at a set time?
faqs.answer: Yes, the premium Halloween page has an optional unlock time. Until then, the link shows only the recipient's name and a countdown, so you can send it early and have it open on the evening of 31 October.

faqs.question: Should I password-protect a pregnancy announcement page?
faqs.answer: If the news is not public yet, it is sensible. 38.5% of SubhSandesh creators add a password before sharing, and a page averages 11.1 views, so assume a link can travel.

faqs.question: What if I'm not ready to announce by 31 October?
faqs.answer: Wait. A November or December announcement reads just as happily, and if you want something seasonal later, the full template gallery has options beyond Halloween.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Halloween Baby Announcement Ideas: Wording, Photos and Timing

A Halloween baby announcement works best when your inner circle already knows, the line is playful without leaning on death jokes, and the photo hides anything identifying. Privacy is a real concern here: 38.5% of SubhSandesh creators password-protect a page before sharing it, and 48.3% of shared pages are opened on a phone, so assume your news will be read on a small screen and could be forwarded. In one survey of 117 pregnant women, the announcement was the single most shared pregnancy update on Facebook. Below: when people usually announce, who to tell first, why 31 October needs extra care, 30 original lines and six photo setups.

## When do people announce a pregnancy, and does 31 October fit?

Most people wait for the first scan. In England, the NHS offers [a dating scan at around 10 to 14 weeks of pregnancy](https://www.nhs.uk/pregnancy/your-pregnancy-care/12-week-scan/), and that appointment is the point many families treat as the green light. Halloween falls on Saturday 31 October 2026 and Sunday 31 October 2027, so a weekend reveal is easy in both years.

The date fits if you are past that scan by late October. As rough arithmetic, someone 12 weeks along on 31 October reaches 40 weeks around mid-May, which makes "a spring baby" an honest teaser. Your midwife or doctor sets the real due date; the post only needs the month.

There is no deadline either. Halloween is one date in a long pregnancy, and an announcement made at 20 weeks in November reads just as happily as one squeezed in before you felt ready.

## Who to tell before Halloween night: a three-ring order

Social posting is usually the last step, not the first. In [Harpel's 2018 survey of pregnant Facebook users](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC5887042), 69.4% had shared their pregnancy announcement there, yet most kept updates to family (77.6%) and friends (78.4%) rather than strangers. The order below protects the people who would be hurt to find out from a feed.

- **Ring one, the co-parent:** agree on the date, the photo and the exact wording together, including what stays off the internet.
- **Ring two, grandparents-to-be and siblings:** a call, a video call or a private link, ideally a few days before 31 October so nobody learns it from a cousin.
- **Ring three, everyone else:** the public post, once rings one and two have had their moment.

Add one more step if a friend has been through infertility or a loss. A private message before the public post ("We wanted you to hear this from us first") gives them room to react in their own time.

## Being kind on 31 October: pregnancy loss and who's reading

Halloween closes a month that already carries baby-loss remembrance. In the US, [Proclamation 5890 of 25 October 1988](https://www.reaganlibrary.gov/archives/speech/proclamation-5890-pregnancy-and-infant-loss-awareness-month-1988) declared October 1988 Pregnancy and Infant Loss Awareness Month. In the UK, [Baby Loss Awareness Week runs 9 to 15 October](https://babyloss-awareness.org/) and closes with a Wave of Light at 7pm on 15 October.

Many people read baby news while carrying a quiet loss. A [2015 US survey of 1,084 adults](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC4443861) found 15% had experienced a miscarriage themselves or with a partner, and of those, 41% said they felt alone. Only the abstract was read for this post.

Two habits follow from that. Skip skeleton-baby and "dead" puns, which sit badly next to someone's grief, and never tag friends in an announcement they did not ask to see.

## 30 Halloween baby announcement lines, sorted by audience

Every line here is original and kid-safe, with no death jokes. Swap the month for your own and keep the photo simple.

### 1. For grandparents-to-be, sent privately

Send one of these with a photo, then call within the hour.

- Your Halloween guest list just got longer: a new grandchild, arriving in May.
- Start knitting something tiny and orange. You're going to be grandparents.
- Next October, you'll have a brand-new reason to buy too many sweets.
- Your sweetest treat is due in spring. Congratulations, Grandma and Grandpa.
- We carved three faces this year. The tiny one is your grandchild.
- No trick this time: you're going to be a Nani.

### 2. For a big brother or sister to announce

Let the older child hold the sign or say the line on video.

- I'm handing over my old pumpkin bucket in May.
- Promoted this Halloween: big brother, starting spring.
- I'm teaching the new baby how to knock for sweets.
- My costume next year comes with a sidekick.
- Guess who gets to share the candy stash soon?

### 3. For a public social post

These suit a caption under a family photo, after the private calls are done.

- Next autumn, our doorstep gets a much shorter visitor.
- Costume count for next Halloween: three.
- A small surprise is on its way. Spring delivery, October debut.
- We have big news and a very small costume to plan.
- The best treat in our bag this year is due in May.
- Halloween in our house just picked up a tiny new member.

### 4. For a rainbow baby after a loss

Keep these gentle and short, and leave out any spooky imagery.

- After a long year, a little light is on its way to us.
- We're carrying hope this October. Baby due in spring.
- Holding our breath, and now holding good news.
- A rainbow is coming after our storm, due in May.

### 5. For a birth announcement, baby already here

For a baby born in late October, these pair with the first photo.

- Arrived just in time to skip the trick and be the treat.
- Our newest pumpkin has landed, with ten tiny toes.
- Born this October and already running the household.
- No costume needed: our new baby is here.
- Welcome, little one. You've made this the sweetest Halloween yet.

### 6. For colleagues or a team chat

Workplace lines stay short and skip personal detail.

- Some news for the team: I'm expecting a baby in May.
- A small announcement this Halloween: our family is growing.
- Treat news: I'll be starting parental leave in spring.
- Happy Halloween, team. We're expecting our first in May.

## Six photo setups that don't need a bump costume

None of these depends on a bump costume, so they work at 12 weeks or 30. Each needs about 20 minutes and things most houses already own.

- **Three buckets:** two adult trick-or-treat buckets on the doorstep beside a tiny one, the due month written on masking tape.
- **Doorstep chalk tally:** "Trick-or-treaters in this house: 2. Next year: 3."
- **Window ghosts at dusk:** two large paper ghosts and one small, taped inside a lit window and shot from the street.
- **The candy split:** the yearly candy-swap table with a third, very small pile labelled with the month.
- **Shadow play:** two adult silhouettes on a lit sheet, with a cut-out bat for the baby.
- **Framed scan in lantern light:** first crop out the clinic name, hospital number and date stamp.

## Halloween announcement formats compared

The table compares four ways to share the news by reach, effort and privacy control.

| Format | Who sees it first | Time to make | Privacy control |
|---|---|---|---|
| Phone or video call | One household at a time | 10–20 minutes per call | Nothing to forward |
| Short Halloween card page | One person, by private link | About 5 minutes, up to 6 photos | Optional password |
| Premium Halloween page | One person, opens at a set time | About 10 minutes, up to 12 photos | Password plus unlock time |
| Public social post | Your whole follower list | 15–30 minutes with a photo | Platform audience settings |

Calls are the most private, and a public post is the least. A link sits in between, but each SubhSandesh page is viewed 11.1 times on average, so expect the link to get passed around.

## Sending it to one person as a Halloween page

A page suits the ring-two person who lives too far to call over: a grandparent abroad, a sibling on a night shift. These are one-person greeting pages with a family mode, not group invitations.

For a quick reveal, the [interactive Halloween card with photos and music](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) takes about five minutes and holds up to 6 photos. Its closing question is editable up to 60 characters, so "Will you be my boo?" can become "Ready to be a grandma?", and you get an email the first time they answer.

For a bigger moment, the [premium Halloween page with a voice note and unlock time](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) takes about ten minutes. It holds 12 photos, a 60-second voice note of the two of you saying it, and an unlock time that shows only their name and a countdown until the evening of 31 October. Its reply box lets them answer once, up to 280 characters, emailed to you.

Build it a day early. In the nearest analogue measured, Raksha Bandhan 2026, 49.4% of pages were built on the festival day itself, n = 89, which leaves no slack for a family surprise. If your news is arriving after October, [the full template gallery](https://subhsandesh.in/templates) has non-Halloween options.

## When a Halloween announcement, or our card, is the wrong choice

Skip the theme if someone close has just had a loss, or if you are not yet comfortable sharing. A plain message in November is kinder than a themed one rushed into October.

Skip the page for a grandparent in the same room, who deserves to see your faces, and for anyone who reads no English, since both page interfaces are in English. A link also travels: if the news must stay inside one household for now, a phone call leaves nothing to forward.

## Sources

- NHS, "12-week scan", page last reviewed 8 November 2023.
- Harpel T, Journal of Medical Internet Research, 22 March 2018.
- Ronald Reagan Presidential Library, Proclamation 5890, 25 October 1988.
- Baby Loss Awareness Week, babyloss-awareness.org, undated.
- Bardos J et al., Obstetrics and Gynecology, June 2015.
